entities.summary: Natalka Karpa, born Nataliya Semenivna Karpa is a Ukrainian singer, TV-host, and the "Distinguished Artist of Ukraine" (2009). She is closely associated with the city of Lviv. Natalka Karpa was a composers & musicians from Dobromyl (b. 1981-08-14, Dobromyl). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
